The '''1964 [[Eliteserien|1. divisjon]]''' was the 20th completed season of top division [[association football|football]] in [[Norway]].
{{TOC limit|2}}

==Overview==
It was contested by 10 teams, and [[Lyn Fotball|FC Lyn Oslo]] won their first championship title. At the time, Lyn Oslo's 26 points were a record for the most points in one season. [[SK Brann|Brann]] and [[Raufoss IL|Raufoss]] were relegated to the [[1. divisjon|2. divisjon]].

This season, two spots in the [[European Cup]] were awarded. Lyn lead the league after 9 rounds and qualified for the [[1964–65 European Cup]]. At the end of the season, Lyn won the league, their first league title, and qualified also for the [[1965–66 European Cup]]. This was the last Norwegian top flight season, the leader after half a season were awarded a European Cup spot.
